unlisted_practices: Two-stage sentence-level then chart-level extraction framework outperforms direct and joint extraction for first-episode onset prediction
Fine-tuning open-source, locally deployable LLMs with LoRA for privacy-sensitive psychiatric record extraction

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks fine-tuned open-source LLMs using a two-stage extraction framework on a retrospective dataset of psychiatric discharge summaries; it does not evaluate an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
